Label: State-Trait Anxiety Inventory - Trait form
Description: State-Trait Anxiety Inventory - Trait form (STAI-T). Measures trait anxiety. 20 items, 4-point scale (keying differs across items). Reference: Spielberger, C. D., Gorsuch, R. L., & Lushene, R. E. (1970). Manual for the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory. Palo Alto, CA: Consulting Psychologists Press. German version: Laux, L., Glanzmann, P., Schaffner, P., & Spielberger, C. D. (1981). Das State-Trait-Angstinventar (STAI). Weinheim: Beltz.
